Thanks Monica — quick thoughts from the hiring side. Alex had multiple strong onsite interviews and is competing with a Bay Area offer. Manager requests we make the package more competitive to improve acceptance. Proposed adjustments:

- Increase base to $180,000 (from $175k)
- Keep target bonus at 10%
- Increase equity to 0.25% (4y vest, 1y cliff)
- Approve a $10,000 sign-on (one-time) if total comp remains within budget constraints

Notes: if finance pushes back on base, I'm open to the compromise of keeping base at $175k but adding the $10k sign-on and the 0.25% equity. Please confirm whether HC-1245 covers this and whether we need a formal headcount reapproval.

-Vivek

Vivek / Monica — reviewed comp band and headcount. Summary of constraints and recommendation: 

- Comp band midpoint for IC3 is $172k; $180k is above midpoint but still within range for strong candidates.
- Headcount HC-1245 is funded for Q2; no additional board-level approval required.
- To balance budget and competitiveness, recommend final package as:
   • Base: $175,000 (as originally proposed)
   • Sign-on: $10,000 (one-time)
   • Target bonus: 10%
   • Equity: 0.20% RSUs (4y, 1y cliff)

That keeps recurring comp within band while giving a meaningful sign-on for acceptance. I can approve this on finance side; hiring manager (Vivek) to confirm manager-level sign-off.

Attaching snapshot of comp band for Q1. If Vivek confirms, Monica can send candidate-facing offer with DocuSign.

-Markus
